title: Transfer Small Molecules - CSV Input
author: Opentrons
materials: P20 Pipette (GEN2) will pick up a tip.

steps.title: Prepare CSV file
steps.instruction: Create a CSV file that lists each transfer with three columns: Source Well, Volume (µL), and Destination Well. Example rows: A1,3,C2; A1,2,B4; A2,5,D7. If using the P20 Multi‑Channel Pipette (GEN2), ensure that only wells in Row A are used for the Destination Well entries.

steps.title: Pick up tip with P20
steps.instruction: Attach the P20 Single‑Channel (or Multi‑Channel) Pipette (GEN2) to the selected mount, then pick up a fresh tip from the tip rack.

steps.title: Mix library in source column
steps.instruction: Using the P20 pipette, aspirate and dispense the liquid in the source column to mix the library before transfer.

steps.title: Transfer specified volume
steps.instruction: For each line in the CSV, aspirate the listed Volume (µL) from the Source Well and dispense it into the Destination Well on the destination plate.

steps.title: Discard used tip
steps.instruction: After each transfer, drop the used tip into the waste bin.

steps.title: Repeat transfers for all CSV lines
steps.instruction: Perform the pick‑up tip, mix, transfer, and discard tip sequence for every row in the CSV file.

steps.title: Mix transferred columns with P300
steps.instruction: After all transfers, use the P300 8‑Channel Pipette (GEN2) to pick up tips and mix each column that received samples. Dispose the first set of tips in the trash; place subsequent used tips into empty slots to conserve waste‑bin space.
